have any choice about their affair. And whoever disobeys Allāh and His Messenger has certainly strayed into clear error.

33:41.text: O you who have believed, remember Allāh with much remembrance

33:42.text: And exalt Him morning and afternoon.

33:43.text: It is He who confers blessing upon you,
